svg.title: B16 ISS BIOGUARD — Retrospective Microgravity Health Evidence engineering architecture
svg.desc: The diagram confines the project to archived retrospective analysis and separates expression from directly reported phenotype evidence. Confounding and absent endpoints remain explicit limits, with no organism manipulation or treatment interpretation.
